notes: [P1] contract/test-gap: in src/game.js, waveSpawner gives a boss wave a spawner count of `options.waveSize + 1` when waveSize is set explicitly, and turns the boss off entirely when waveSize is 0. The comment on createGame says an explicit waveSize 'holds for every wave', but on waves 5 and 10 it no longer does. test/boss.test.js relies on the waveSize: 0 case, yet no test pins what an explicit nonzero waveSize does on a boss wave. That leaves the override contract implicit and easy to break.

[P1] test-gap: leakEnemies still returns leaked.length, the number of ghosts that leaked, while it now takes BOSS_LIVES lives for a boss. So the return value no longer matches the lives lost. No test pins what the return value means after this change, so any caller that reads it as lives lost would be silently off by 2 for each boss.

[P2] naming/semantics: the brief says the HUD announces a boss wave 'when it starts'. hudModel.bossWave stays true for the whole wave, so 'Boss wave' is still drawn after the boss is banished. The comment in src/hud.js documents this choice, so it is acceptable, but the label lingers after the threat is gone.
